title: Buy Emerald Leads Today!
author: Zombie Containment (ZC) Labs Inc
pages: Did your loved one turn into a zombie villager? Is your friend sick and turning green? Are you running the defense of a village?
All of these situations can be heartbreaking and terrifying! But don’t worry, we have a tool to help you: The Emerald Lead!
The Emerald Golems grabs any zombie villager or infected villager so you can take them to a place that is safe for you and them!
There, you can tie them up until you can find them a cure. The best part? The zombie villager will be so enchanted by the emerald lead that they will lose interest in attacking anyone else!

Also, all golems are programmed to not attack villagers with an emerald lead attached to them so your loved ones don’t get their head bashed in and resources are not spent attacking villagers that are contained!
Buy them today at your local bank!
